content.title: Identity Board Variant | Eye Hook, Turntable Proof, Hero Card
content.summary: Establish one original fictional nonhuman doll character with at least three stable visual anchors in an extreme detail. Pull back to a complete silhouette and repeat the same anchors inside a clear identity card. Provide front, side and back verification without redesigning proportions, hair, outfit or companion prop. Use detail macros and one stage transformation to test the same identity across scale and lighting. Return to the complete unchanged character and one original name field in a stable hero card.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one original fictional nonhuman doll character with at least three stable visual anchors in an extreme detail. + Pull back to a complete silhouette and repeat the same anchors inside a clear identity card. + Provide front, side and back verification without redesigning proportions, hair, outfit or companion prop. + Use detail macros and one stage transformation to test the same identity across scale and lighting. + Return to the complete unchanged character and one original name field in a stable hero card.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on an extreme macro of one teal hexagonal lens belonging to an original clearly nonhuman clockwork moth courier; lock the lens, indigo wing edges and one copper antenna joint. Show exact front, left side and back turntable views of the same nonhuman design; wing count, lens shape, copper joints, envelope and proportions never change. Return to the complete unchanged moth and envelope on the ivory card; show only the exact original name 'NIX COURIER' and hold.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one original fictional nonhuman doll character with at least three stable visual anchors in an extreme detail. Pull back to a complete silhouette and repeat the same anchors inside a clear identity card. Provide front, side and back verification without redesigning proportions, hair, outfit or companion prop. Use detail macros and one stage transformation to test the same identity across scale and lighting. Return to the complete unchanged character and one original name field in a stable hero card.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original fictional nonhuman doll character with at least three stable visual anchors in an extreme detail. Pull back to a complete silhouette and repeat the same anchors inside a clear identity card. Provide front, side and back verification without redesigning proportions, hair, outfit or companion prop. Use detail macros and one stage transformation to test the same identity across scale and lighting. Return to the complete unchanged character and one original name field in a stable hero card. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one original fictional nonhuman doll character with at least three stable visual anchors in an extreme detail.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Pull back to a complete silhouette and repeat the same anchors inside a clear identity card.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Provide front, side and back verification without redesigning proportions, hair, outfit or companion prop.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Use detail macros and one stage transformation to test the same identity across scale and lighting.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Return to the complete unchanged character and one original name field in a stable hero card.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source doll character, childlike proportions, face, hair and outfit
source cat companion, bows, striped stockings and gothic motifs
source MIDNIGHT DOLL and other lettering
source exact model sheet, macros, stage, camera path and timing
source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, platform marks and thread wording
